Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: "Avulsion": timed degron depletion to separate establishment from maintenance
ideas.description: Drawing on avulsion (a sudden tearing-away) and fallway/unsloped (decay path vs. plateau), tag FOS and JUN with dTAG or auxin degrons, deliver a defined stimulus pulse, then acutely strip AP-1 at staggered delays while tracking accessibility (ATAC) and occupancy (CUT&RUN). Memory predicts a handoff whereby early depletion collapses the primed state but late depletion leaves an unsloped plateau; run with and without cell-cycle arrest to distinguish replication-coupled dilution from active erasure, and repeat with FOS/FOSB/JUNB swaps to test which family member (allonymous) carries the memory.

ideas.title: "Verveled" lineages: heritable barcoding to measure how long memory survives mitosis
ideas.description: A vervel is the owner's identifying ring on a hawk's leg; analogously, heritably barcode single cells (Watermelon/CellTag plus single-cell multiome), stimulate, allow several divisions, then restimulate and ask whether primed accessibility and faster re-induction propagate down clonal trees. The key measurement is the decay constant of sister- and cousin-cell correlation in AP-1 site accessibility as a function of generation number, distinguishing true inheritance from stochastic resampling.

ideas.title: Lexicon vs. usage: causal test that retained AP-1 sites drive the second response
ideas.description: The material is a list of words that exist in the dictionary but are almost never used, highlighting that an element being present is not evidence it is functional; likewise an open chromatin site is not necessarily a working memory element. Challenge primed cells with a second stimulus and measure nascent transcription (TT-seq, Pol II CUT&RUN, or live MS2 imaging of burst frequency and latency), then CRISPRi-silence or delete the retained AP-1 elements to test whether the potentiation disappears.

ideas.title: "Insulator": testing whether AP-1 memory is a bounded 3D neighborhood property
ideas.description: Taking the word insulator literally, map Micro-C and CTCF alongside ATAC before, during, and after stimulation, then degrade cohesin/RAD21 and insert synthetic CTCF boundaries adjacent to a memory locus. If primed accessibility spreads in cis and is halted by an engineered boundary, AP-1 memory is a property of an insulated neighborhood rather than an independent per-site mark.

ideas.title: "Quadratics": hysteresis and bistability in synthetic AP-1 site arrays
ideas.description: Build synthetic reporter arrays that vary AP-1 site number, spacing (spithame, a hand-span measure), and affinity, then measure the complete up-going and down-going dose-response to a tunable stimulus. A genuine memory mechanism should display hysteresis, with non-overlapping ascending and descending curves and a sharp switch-like threshold in site number, whereas a passively relaxing system retraces the same curve in both directions.
